summary: Implemented `prosevoice migrate` (skills/prosevoice/scripts/prosevoice_lib/migration.py), bounded to the contract in migration.md. Project/user scopes; preview by default, with no writes on preview or blocked preflight. Strict legacy config validation and translation to schema_version 1. Byte-exact copies of guides and policy. Cache sidecars are copied with link rebasing, and nested duplicate stems are handled. Known-hash recognition of PV-PROTOCOL.md/BLOG_VOICE.md files and pv-protocol/blog-voice blocks at every supported target, using the shared conservative block parser and requiring a prosevoice installation. Equivalence of guidance, policy union, artifact mode and READY visuals is verified through the shared resolver before rules are activated last. A manifest with before/after hashes, staged bytes and backups supports resume, and conflict detection names the file and manifest. Recovery instructions are returned in the report. Small shared-layer refactors (build_config, state_of, text parsers, image_outcome) avoid duplicate resolution logic. Added tests/test_prosevoice_migration.py (32 tests) and legacy rule fixtures. Migration checks: 32 OK; full suite: 142 OK; ruff clean; wheel builds. Legacy skill trees unchanged; nothing committed.

interpretations_for_review: An active anchor with no decision anywhere does not block migration; its already-blocked READY outcome is preserved and reported. Unmappable decisions do block.
Manifests in .prosevoice/migrations/ are not git-ignored by migration; integration docs should state the policy.
Legacy rule recognition is limited to the five released protocol texts; anything else blocks for manual review.
remaining_for_later_steps: legacy tree removal and doc updates (integration)
